D: A top London cop is reassigned to a quiet country village where the accidents keep piling up.
P: Serve the drinks when Angel orders a cranberry juice at the pub.
S: Mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, chutney, apple and crusty bread

Thick slices of mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, a chunky brown pickle, apple and crusty bread with salted butter on a wooden board. Take 250g mature cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead and cut into thick slices. Cut a pork pie into wedges. Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, a sliced apple, crusty bread and a dish of salted butter.
Village of the Year fete scotch eggs
Soft boiled eggs wrapped in sausage, crumbed and fried, with English mustard

Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Wrap each in 100g seasoned sausage mince. Roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 7 minutes, halve and serve with English mustard.
Greater good cheddar and leek rarebit
Mature cheddar, English mustard and soft leek bubbling on thick sourdough toast

Served at every Neighbourhood Watch Alliance meeting, for the greater good. Soften a sliced leek in 30g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 100ml milk, and cook until thick. Off the heat beat in 250g grated mature cheddar, 2 tsp English mustard and an egg yolk. Toast 4 thick slices of sourdough, spread the cheese thickly to the edges and grill until bubbling and browned in spots. Cut into fingers and scatter with chives.
M: Beef braised in ale and baked under puff pastry, served with chips

Beef chuck braised in dark ale with onion, thyme and a little Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme, 375ml ale and a dash of Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and pour into a pie dish. Cover with puff, bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with chips and 300g peas.
Supermarket roast chicken and bread sauce
the village supermarket with its smiling manager

Whole chicken roasted golden, with roast potatoes cooked in the chicken fat, honey roast carrots and a creamy clove-studded bread sauce. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter and salt and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, and rest. Parboil 1kg potatoes, roast in the chicken fat for 50 minutes. Toss 500g carrots in honey and oil and roast 30 minutes. Simmer 400ml milk with an onion studded with 4 cloves for 10 minutes, remove the onion and stir in 80g fresh breadcrumbs and 20g butter.
W: Vanilla ice cream rippled with strawberry in chocolate and peanut dipped cones
Waffle cones filled with strawberry ice cream rippled with fresh strawberry sauce, dipped in dark chocolate and chopped nuts, frozen until serving.
K: Angel's cranberry lime cooler, no ice
Chilled cranberry juice shaken with ginger syrup and lime, no ice

Cranberry juice chilled hard and shaken with fresh lime and a little ginger syrup, poured into a cold pint glass with no ice, topped with soda. Chill 800ml cranberry juice and four pint glasses in the fridge for 3 hours. Simmer 60g sugar, 60ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each glass, shake 200ml cranberry juice with the juice of half a lime and 15ml ginger syrup, pour into a cold pint glass and top with soda water. No ice.

Brown the beef in batches and soften the sliced onions.
Add thyme, ale and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and braise gently until the beef is tender.
